_comment: Fallback display metadata for the dashboard. surface/methods/<id>/pipeline.json and each run's method_info.json take precedence. expected_minutes here are rough UI estimates, not measurements.

methods.name: Poisson Surface Reconstruction
methods.paper: Kazhdan, Bolitho, Hoppe. Poisson Surface Reconstruction. SGP 2006
methods.description: Solves a Poisson equation for an indicator function whose gradient matches the oriented point normals, then extracts its iso-surface (own implementation, no library API).
methods.colour: shape only; texture baked from the input points

methods.name: IER meshing (intrinsic-extrinsic ratio)
methods.paper: Liu, Zhang, Su. Meshing Point Clouds with Predicted Intrinsic-Extrinsic Ratio Guidance. ECCV 2020
methods.description: Proposes candidate triangles from k-nearest neighbours; a network predicts each candidate's intrinsic-extrinsic (geodesic/Euclidean) ratio, and the best-scoring non-conflicting triangles are kept.
methods.colour: shape only; texture baked from the input points

methods.name: Point2Mesh
methods.paper: Hanocka, Metzer, Giryes, Cohen-Or. Point2Mesh: A Self-Prior for Deformable Meshes. SIGGRAPH 2020
methods.description: Deforms an initial coarse mesh with a MeshCNN self-prior optimised only on this cloud (no training set), with progressive upsampling.
methods.colour: shape only; texture baked from the input points

methods.name: MeshAnything
methods.paper: Chen et al. MeshAnything: Artist-Created Mesh Generation with Autoregressive Transformers. ICLR 2025 (arXiv 2406.10163)
methods.description: A pretrained autoregressive transformer conditioned on a point-cloud encoding emits a compact, artist-style low-poly mesh face by face.
methods.colour: shape only; texture baked from the input points

methods.name: Deep Hybrid Self-Prior (DHSP)
methods.paper: Wei, Chen, Fu, Cui, Zhang. Deep Hybrid Self-Prior for Full 3D Mesh Generation. ICCV 2021
methods.description: Self-supervised: a 3D graph-convolution self-prior deforms the mesh while a 2D UV-atlas CNN self-prior refines geometry and predicts colour, so shape and colour come from the method itself.
methods.colour: shape and colour predicted by the method

input_frame.evidence: Head (hair) is towards -Y and the shoes towards +Y; the jersey's 'SPAIN' name and number (printed on the back of a football shirt) face +Z, so the person faces -Z.
